content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters: Payment gateway

A no-KYC payment gateway allows digital creators to accept cryptocurrency payments without the typical verification requirements imposed by traditional financial institutions. This is crucial for individuals in regions where access to conventional banking is limited or where financial systems are under strain. These gateways facilitate transactions in a decentralized manner, allowing creators to retain full ownership of their funds and data. Unlike platforms like Gumroad, which charge significant fees on every transaction, no-KYC solutions like NOWPayments charge a mere 0.5%, allowing creators to maximize their earnings.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The infrastructure behind no-KYC payment gateways typically involves a combination of decentralized technologies and smart contracts that facilitate transactions. For example, a digital creator can set up their store using a combination of GitHub Pages for hosting, Google Apps Script for backend logic, and NOWPayments for payment processing. When a customer makes a purchase, the payment is processed on-chain, ensuring immediate confirmation and delivery of the digital product. This architecture not only simplifies the payment process but also enhances security and reduces reliance on third-party platforms.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This infrastructure is specifically designed for digital creators operating in regions that are often overlooked by mainstream payment processors. It serves those who sell digital products such as ebooks, courses, templates, and software but find themselves unable to leverage platforms like PayPal or Stripe. By utilizing no-KYC gateways, these creators can focus on their work without the barriers imposed by traditional financial systems. The architecture empowers them to sell directly to their audience while maintaining control over their sales, data, and revenue.
Save significantly on transaction fees with no-KYC solutions like NOWPayments.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The effectiveness of a no-KYC payment gateway relies on a cohesive architecture comprising various components. Essential tools include GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting the storefront, Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers for managing backend logic, and NOWPayments for cryptocurrency payment processing. Each component seamlessly integrates, allowing for an automated workflow where customers receive their purchased digital products instantly upon confirmation of payment. This combination not only reduces costs but also enhances the overall user experience, making it easier for creators to manage their sales.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To get started with a no-KYC payment gateway, first choose your digital products and prepare them for sale. Next, set up your online store using GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, ensuring it's optimized for customer engagement. Integrate Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers to handle backend operations, such as order processing and delivery. After that, sign up for NOWPayments to facilitate cryptocurrency transactions. Finally, test the entire system to confirm that payments are processed smoothly and that customers receive their products instantly. This streamlined process allows creators to focus on their craft while ensuring their payment infrastructure is robust and reliable.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

Selling an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe can be effectively accomplished using no-KYC payment gateways. By leveraging platforms like NOWPayments, digital creators can accept cryptocurrency payments directly, bypassing the need for traditional banking solutions. This approach not only simplifies the transaction process but also minimizes fees, allowing creators to keep more of their earnings.
Maintain full ownership of your sales data without relying on third-party platforms.

NOWPayments handles the checkout. Your backend handles the delivery. You keep 99.5% of every sale. Both paths lead to a store you own completely. See both at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Identify the digital products you want to sell and prepare them for distribution. Choose a hosting solution like GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages to set up your store. Integrate backend logic using Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers for order management. Sign up for NOWPayments to handle cryptocurrency transactions. Test the system thoroughly to ensure smooth payment processing and instant product delivery.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

You can sell an ebook online using a no-KYC payment gateway like NOWPayments. Set up a digital storefront using GitHub Pages, integrate the payment solution, and deliver your ebook automatically after payment.
What is the best way to sell digital downloads without platform fees?
Using a no-KYC payment gateway allows you to minimize transaction fees significantly. For instance, NOWPayments charges only 0.5%, compared to platforms like Gumroad that charge 10%.
Can I sell templates and fonts without using Gumroad or Payhip?
Absolutely. By leveraging a no-KYC payment gateway, you can sell templates and fonts directly to your audience while retaining full control of the sales process and costs.
What cryptocurrencies can I accept?
NOWPayments supports over 300 cryptocurrencies, allowing you to accept a wide range of digital currencies as payment for your products.
Is there a way to automate product delivery?
Yes, by using Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers, you can automate the delivery of your digital products immediately after payment is confirmed.
